title: Implement task/attempt park, block, resume, cancel, transfer and non-source closure

checkpoint.summary: V2-07 implemented audited park/block/resume/cancel/abandon/reopen, atomic review settlement, explicit owner transfer with a new source binding, and independently approved no-source task closure. Source commit fbd8bff, experimental protocol 3.33.
checkpoint.nextAction: V2-07 accepted. V2-09 task-spec APIs and V2-12 integration reconciliation remain ready; V2-14 migration also requires V2-09 and V2-13. No production deployment or migration.
verified: Assigned/Acknowledged/Ready/Working park/block, Completed versus agent Parked, and explicit resume/queued generation
New generation cannot revive stale receipt or bypass orchestrator reissue
CancelTask and TransferOwner atomically withdraw active Unclaimed or Claimed reviews and audit the disposition
Cancelling previous task preserves unrelated newer Working slot and late feedback acknowledgment
Transfer retains prior source/review/spec evidence but gives successor no implicit source checkout binding
Independent no-source closure requires Finished attempt, non-owner approval, criteria/evidence and no source/review/integration
Immutable no-source approval retrievable by sequence; no claim of source integration
Open cancel, abandon, terminal reopen and fresh assignment retain historical records
End-to-end V2 client lifecycle history and cancel/reopen; MCP permissions and discovery
Final Client.Tests 348/348, Server.Tests 62/62, git diff --check clean; protocol 3.33
